subject: Nebula Tech - Consumption snapshot + peak TPS / budget confirmation
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@nebula.tech>
Cc: Priya Ramesh <priya.r@nebula.tech>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + asks from today's call (consumption & peak TPS)

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick write-up while it's fresh so we can lock the inputs for pricing and the MAP:

Summary from our side:
- Primary integration: normalized conversational assistant (NLP summarization + clarification flows).
- Expected production traffic: ~8–15M tokens / month in steady state (initial pilot target ~6M for Q3).
- Peak windows: batch notification hours plus morning surge — you estimated short bursts up to ~250–350 TPS for ~10–20 minute windows.
- Critical asks: SLA for 99th latency, burst capacity for short windows, and a target $/1M token price to fit procurement bands.

Open items we need you to confirm so I can lock commercial options:
1) Confirm a 1–3 month ramp shape (flat vs front-loaded). If you expect a spike on day 1 of release, call that out.
2) Confirm target $/1M tokens range you have in mind (you mentioned $75–$150 as an internal target on the call).
3) Who will be the procurement lead and the timeline for an SOW (so we can align DocuSign + security checklist).

Next steps from me: I'll assemble two pricing bands (conservative and aggressive) with explicit burst allowance and proposed MAP. Attaching a short draft proposal + MAP template for intake — feel free to redline.

Attachments: Nebula_Proposal_2026-06.pdf (pricing bands + SLA), mutual_action_plan_nebula.xlsx (MAP template)

If you can confirm items 1–3 above by tomorrow EOD I can send a formal quote and an option for a 30-day pilot.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Samir Patel <samir@nebula.tech>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Ramesh <priya.r@nebula.tech>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + asks from today's call (consumption & peak TPS)

Thanks Ava — great summary. A few clarifications below: 

1) Ramp: Pilot (Q3) will be front-loaded — we expect the first 2 weeks after release to be ~60% of the monthly pilot traffic as many users will discover the feature quickly. After that we see normalizing to the steady state. So plan for a short early spike.

2) Target $/1M tokens: our internal target is in the $90–$130 / 1M range. We want to see options that get us toward the low end if possible (higher volume discounts / committed slab).

3) Procurement lead: Priya Ramesh (cc'd) is the procurement lead — timeline: internal approvals by July 8, SOW signature target July 20. 

Additional notes:
- Peak TPS: our telemetry team reported simulated loads that hit ~320 TPS for two 12-minute windows during the beta run. We're comfortable with a short burst window (sub-20 minutes) but need explicit burst allowance in the SLA and a fallback model if you need to route to lower-cost models during sustained overload.
- Security: we'll request the SOC2 + retention policy during procurement; can you share the links?

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk pricing bands.

—Samir
Director of Product, Nebula Tech
samir@nebula.tech | (312) 555-0117

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@nebula.tech>
Cc: Priya Ramesh <priya.r@nebula.tech>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + asks from today's call (consumption & peak TPS)

Samir — thanks for the clarifications and the procurement timeline. Short responses inline below and next steps: 

- Ramp / spike: noted (front-loaded). I'll include a short-duration 'initial surge' allowance in the pricing scenarios (two options: one for normalized steady-state and one that includes a billed-but-guaranteed short burst pool for the first 14 days).

- Pricing range: we'll target two offers that hit $95/1M (committed 6–12 month slab) and $125/1M (month-to-month with burst add-on). Both options will show unit economics and expected monthly invoice at 8M, 12M, and 15M token points.

- SLA / burst handling: proposed approach — guaranteed burst pool covering up to +50% of provisioned 99th TPS for a 20-minute window, and automatic fallback to a compatible quantized model if sustained beyond the burst window with a notice-and-fallback policy. I'll document the fallback behavior clearly in the proposal.

- Security docs: Marissa — can you paste the SOC2 + retention links below?

Next steps (from Redwood):
1) I'll send the formal proposal + MAP (attached) with two pricing bands by EOD today.
2) If you'd like, schedule a 20-minute pricing walk-through next week (I have Tue/Wed morning slots PT).
3) Marissa will attach SOC2 evidence and retention policy links.

If that all looks good I'll prepare the quote for the July 20 SOW target.

Thanks,
Ava

Marissa — quick internal: forwarding Samir's confirmation and the procurement timeline. Key asks for your review:

- Recommended commercial approach for approval:
  * Option A (Committed slab): 12M token commit / month -> target $95 / 1M (NEB-2026-012-A). Includes 20-minute burst pool at +50% capacity for first 14 days and standard SLA.
  * Option B (Flex month-to-month): 8–15M elastic -> $125 / 1M with burst add-on pricing and automatic fallback policy (NEB-2026-012-B).

- Requested discount threshold for early-sign (before July 20): can we offer a 7% promotional credit applied to the first two invoices?
- Attachments: proposal + MAP are attached for customer-facing delivery.
- Security: Samir asked for SOC2 and retention policy links — can you paste them and confirm expected turnaround for any additional evidence (encryption, KMS notes)?

Please advise if PO approval should go to standard AE discount matrix or sales leader exception. I want to have the formal quote ready by EOD so we can hit July 20.

Thanks,
Ava
